errors.text_span: за Европейския съюз (ЕС) и неговите старите страни членки (EC-15)
errors.evidence: The chart compares two groups, EC-15 and EC-13, not the entire EU against the EC-15 group. The description misinterprets the comparison being made.
The horizontal axis and the data presented extend to the year 2018, not 2017.

errors.text_span: като се измерва всеки период от две години
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is marked with labels for every single year from 2000 to 2018, not every two years.
The vertical axis has a range from -8.0 up to 8.0, not 6%.

errors.text_span: През 2012 г. има зрелищна „празнота“ по оста на времето.
errors.evidence: There is no gap, empty space, or missing data for the year 2012 on the chart's time axis. All years from 2000 to 2018 are present.
The word 'зрелищна' (spectacular) is subjective and evaluative, which violates the prompt's requirement for neutral and objective language.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за EC-15 са показани в оранжев цвят, а тези за EC-13 са показани в сив цвят.
errors.evidence: The description swaps the colors of the two categories. According to the legend, EC-15 is represented by grey bars and EC-13 is represented by orange bars.

errors.text_span: Най-високата стойност за EC-15 е около 5,4% през 2006 г.
errors.evidence: The highest value for EC-15 (grey bars) is in the year 2000, at approximately 4.6%. The value in 2006 is approximately 3.6%. Both the year and the value are incorrect.

errors.text_span: най-ниската стойност е около -2,3% през 2009 г.
errors.evidence: The lowest value for EC-15 (grey bar) in 2009 is approximately -4.5%, not -2.3%.

errors.text_span: най-високата стойност е около 5,0% през 2006 г.
errors.evidence: The highest value for EC-13 (orange bars) is in 2007, at approximately 6.8%. The value in 2006 is also high (approx. 6.7%), but the stated value of 5.0% is a significant underestimate for either year.

errors.text_span: а най-ниската е около -1,7% през 2009 г.
errors.evidence: The lowest value for EC-13 (orange bar) in 2009 is approximately -6.8%, not -1.7%. The reported value is extremely inaccurate.
The description fails to mention that the chart is a grouped bar chart, which is a key structural feature requested by the prompt for this type of visualization.
